digest.component_or_area: MCP server config ownership seam enforcement
propositions: Below-seam ambient config and credential reads in mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be routed through new owned composition-root resolvers in config.py instead of reading directly below the seam
Three new owned resolvers must be added to config.py: mcp_gate (typed bool gate, fail-closed), compose_config (process-root config entry), and read_secret_env (secret value resolution at boundary)

All load_config() calls and os.environ.get reads for auth secrets in the MCP files must be eliminated and replaced with calls to the new config.py resolvers while preserving per-request resolution semantics
LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS entries for mcp_server.py and _mcp_auth.py must be removed from scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py and check_config_ownership.py must report zero findings for these paths
MCP subsystem behavioral suites (tests/interfaces/facades and tests/unit MCP/auth suites) must remain green and unmodified after the cutover, confirming no behavioral delta
